139.long_description: The Game Wizard Xtreme 3.0 arcade machine is finally available for purchase, with pre-order and bonuses open in February. The Xtreme 3 supports almost all JAMMA/JVS with native input of 15khz, 24khz, 31khz, up to 1080P including RGB, VGA and HDMI input. Our Xtreme machine is the most advanced arcade cabinet in the market, allowing you to also almost any current consoles and PCs. Multiple add ons are available. The Game Wizard Xtreme 3 in the updated version of the machine originally launched in Australia in 2012/13 and allows owners to "plug and play" Jamma arcade game boards, as well as JVS USB arcade games boards. Through the Highway IO board, you can also use the machine to "plug and play" a variety of consoles and PCs. The list currently includes; Android JAMMA Game Boards JVS Arcade Boards MiSTer FPGA Neo Geo FightStick Neo-Geo Mini Nintendo Switch Oculus Rift VR PC Playstation 3 Playstation 4 Playstation 5 Raspberry Pi Sega Astro City Mini Sega Genesis Mini Steam Deck Xbox 360 Xbox One S X Xbox Series S X Oh, and adding any of the current combo games boxes is as easy as plugging in the USB and HDMI cables. Looking for even more functions and options? We have over 800 variations either released, or coming onto the marketplace soon. Add a second or 3rd monitor for your game artwork that changes when you change your games, or, how about gun holsters with pedal assembly for your gun shooters. Lots more features will announced soon. Preorder in February offers a number of bonuses and each cabinet is built to your specifications. Please register your interest, and we will be in touch with all details.
